label: GPT-6.1 Sol
output:
Rick, I’m still pissed about what happened with Gary, and “that’s business, sis, can’t win ’em all” really rubbed me the wrong way. This isn’t about losing a listing. That happens. It’s about you promising my time and quoting my commission without asking me.

You told Gary I’d list his house for 1% as a “family rate.” My listing side is 2.5%. I never offered him 1%, and you don’t get to offer it for me. Gary is your buddy, not someone I agreed to do a favor for.

I spent about six hours Saturday pulling comps, doing the walkthrough, and putting together a full listing packet, plus the drive from north Phoenix. I’m not really mad at Gary for choosing ListLite. He made his decision. I’m mad that you put me in that position and then brushed it off when I told you about it.

And now, before we’ve even sorted this out, you’ve given Denise my cell so she can “pick my brain.” This happened with your softball friend two years ago, too. I let it go then, but I’m not letting it become the arrangement. You get to offer your friends a favor, and I’m the one expected to deliver it for free.

I’m happy to help Mom, your kids, and actual family with advice. That does not mean everyone you know gets my time or a commission you decided on.

From now on, ask me first, every time. No handing out my number, no quoting my commission, and no promising I’ll help someone before I’ve agreed. I’m not calling Denise. You need to tell her you gave her my number without checking with me.

I love you, and I’m still coming to Thanksgiving. But I need you to take this seriously and respect that this is my livelihood, not a favor you can hand out.
